subject: Clearview Health: Onramp access & API key activation plan
messages:
From: Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@clearviewhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Peters <jamal.peters@clearviewhealth.com>, procurement@clearviewhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes - API access and invites

Thanks for the kickoff this morning, Rishi. Two quick asks so our internal teams can move: 

1) A concise checklist of the exact credentials and roles we need to create on our side (service accounts vs user invites).
2) A recommended cadence for seeding API keys and rotating them during the trial period.

We have a security review next Tuesday and if we can share that checklist today it would help unblock the procurement sign-off.

- Sara
Director, Platform Integrations
Clearview Health

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@clearviewhealth.com>, Jamal Peters <jamal.peters@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes - API access and invites

Sara — sending the high-level "onramp concertina" plan below (attached is a short MTP and a CSV roles template). I tried to keep it checklist-friendly for procurement/security. TL;DR: we recommend seeding one service API key for initial integration + creating two admin users in the org for role handoff. Key points: 

- P0 (day 0-2): Seed a single service API key (scoped to project:test) for integration testing. Store in your KMS and share only a redacted audit URL with our CS lead.
- P1 (day 3-7): Invite two Clearview admin users (one security lead, one infra lead) into the workspace with Owner and Billing Viewer roles respectively. Use the attached org_roles_template.csv to map names->roles.
- P2 (week 2): Rotate the initial service key, create a per-environment key for dev/prod, and enable KV/prefix caching policy.
- Security notes: recommend enabling ephemeral short-lived tokens for application-level reads after the trial; we can provide the token rotating lambda snippet.

Ask for you: reply with the two admin invite emails and confirm whether procurement needs a separate DPA clause (I pasted DocuSign link in related_links).

Attachments: clearview_onboarding_mtp.pdf (3 pages), org_roles_template.csv

Thanks — I’ll sync with Monica on delivery tasks.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jamal Peters <jamal.peters@clearviewhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes - API access and invites

Thanks Rishi — quick answers inline: 

- We will use a hardware KMS (Azure Key Vault). Ok to create the first API key and we will import/store a rotated key later.
- Admin invites: sending Kate Lin (kate.lin@clearviewhealth.com) as Security Admin, and Mark Orr (mark.orr@clearviewhealth.com) as Platform Owner.
- Procurement: they want the standard DPA + a short note about logs retention (30 days). Procurement (procurement@clearviewhealth.com) is looped here.

Jamal
Senior Engineering Manager, Clearview Health

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@clearviewhealth.com>, Jamal Peters <jamal.peters@clearviewhealth.com>, procurement@clearviewhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes - API access and invites

Copying the implementation plan and owners for the next 7 days. I'll own the seeding runbook and David will handle the key rotation script. Ben will support billing/account setup. Action items (owner - due):

- Create initial service API key scoped to project:clearview-trial (David) - due: 2026-06-19 11:00 PT
- Invite Kate Lin (Security Admin) and Mark Orr (Platform Owner) to the workspace with roles assigned per CSV (Monica) - due: 2026-06-19 14:00 PT
- Provide procurement with retention and DPA summary (Ben) - due: 2026-06-19 16:00 PT
- Share staged DocuSign envelope for signature (Rishi) - due: 2026-06-19 18:00 PT

Notes: We'll create the service key as a scoped token (no billing privileges). Once procurement signs, we can issue environment keys and enable the rotational lambda. Attaching the short runbook excerpt in-line below for quick copy/paste.

--- runbook excerpt ---
1) Create service key in control plane -> scope to project:clearview-trial -> set read/write:messages false (reduce blast radius)
2) Save key fingerprint; register in Clearview KMS as external key alias
3) Invite admins using Invite flow -> select roles per org_roles_template.csv
4) Verify telemetry by running a 10-call smoke test to the /v1/generate endpoint

Monica
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: procurement@clearviewhealth.com <procurement@clearviewhealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@clearviewhealth.com>, Jamal Peters <jamal.peters@clearviewhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes - API access and invites

Ben / Rishi — we reviewed the DPA and retention note. Procurement approved subject to: (1) logs retention set to 30 days and (2) proof of audit logging turned on for admin events. Please provide a brief confirmation email once these settings are enabled and we will sign the DocuSign.

Procurement Team
Clearview Health

Replying to confirm: Monica (implementation) — once David flips on audit logging and sets retention to 30 days, can you send procurement a one-line confirmation and we'll proceed to sign?
